raw: {"analysis":"XLH provides a more actionable and complete delivery plan, correctly addressing all repository constraints while offering specific implementation details like payload fingerprinting, PII risk mitigation, and concrete rollback triggers. JPD covers the constraints adequately but is more procedural and less technically prescriptive, particularly around the black-box correlation strategy and build budget management. XLH's treatment of the flaky check handling and staging verification is more operationally grounded.","verdict":"XLH"}
